entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shaili Ganguly Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.173 of 2023 at Police Station-Garh Mukteshwar, District-Hapur under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 17.04.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 09.06.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Raj Kumar Kesari, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Ms. Shaili Ganguly, learned counsel for the informant and Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Smt. Ina vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98867811/
1
1. The applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased.
2. The applicant never tortured the deceased nor did she demand dowry.
3. She never interfered in the marital life of the deceased and her husband.
The applicant is bereaved by the death of her daughter-in-law.
4. The deceased was a sensitive lady.
She was depressed on account of physical disability of her child.
5. On the fateful day, she succumbed to depression and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.

6. The postmortem report opines that:
(i). The cause of death due to combined effect of asphyxia, venous congestion due to antemortem hanging.
(ii).
No abnormality was detected in the hyoid bone.
(iii).

Ligature marks were found (which are consistent with the hanging).
7.
Antemortem injuries reflected in the postmortem report caused when body was lowered down from its hanging position.
8. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
9. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
10. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
11. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of her influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Smt. Ina be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
Smt. Ina vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98867811/
2
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Dhananjai  Smt. Ina vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98867811/
